battle.name: 阿富汗戰爭
battle.brief: 2001年10月美軍在阿富汗山區展開「持久自由」行動，使用M4卡賓槍、M249機槍等輕武器掃蕩塔利班據點。

kit.name: M4卡賓槍
kit.history: 1994年定型，2001年部署至阿富汗山區，取代M16。

countries: 2001 年 10 月 7 日，美國在英國的支援下正式啟動「持久自由行動」，成為聯軍的核心。美國調派了海軍第 5 艦隊的航空母艦戰鬥群、空軍第 8 航空隊的 B‑2 與 B‑1 轟炸機以及多架 F‑15、F‑16 戰鬥機，兵力在阿富汗境內快速集結約 2,500 人；英國皇家空軍派遣颱風與旋風戰機、皇家海軍提供海上支援，兵力約 1,500 人；加拿大特種部隊聯合計劃小組（JTF2）於 11 月初抵達，部署約 200 名特勤；澳洲皇家特種空勤團（SASR）亦在 10 月底派員加入，約 300 人；德國、法國、義大利與土耳其等北約盟國則提供後勤、醫療與空中加油等支援，兵力合計約 1,000 人。此多國聯合作戰結構在 2001 年底前已完成部署，為後續地面行動奠定了廣泛的國際支援基礎。
countriesEn: On October 7 2001, the United States, with the United Kingdom as its principal ally, officially launched Operation Enduring Freedom, establishing the core of the multinational coalition. The U.S. deployed the carrier battle group of the 5th Fleet, Air Force 8th Air Force B‑2 and B‑1 bombers, and multiple F‑15 and F‑16 fighters, quickly assembling roughly 2,500 troops inside Afghanistan. The United Kingdom contributed Royal Air Force Typhoon and Tornado aircraft and Royal Navy maritime support, numbering about 1,500 personnel. Canada’s Joint Task Force 2 (JTF2) arrived in early November with about 200 special‑operations troops. Australia’s Special Air Service Regiment (SASR) sent around 300 troops in late October. Germany, France, Italy, Turkey and other NATO allies provided logistics, medical and aerial‑refueling support, bringing the total contribution to roughly 1,000 additional soldiers. This multinational structure was essentially in place by the end of 2001, laying a broad international foundation for subsequent ground operations.
people: 在持久自由行動初期，美國特種作戰司令部（USSOCOM）調動了第 75 遊騎兵團的營級分隊、陸軍特種部隊第 1 大隊的多支作戰分遣隊（ODA），以及海軍海豹突擊隊（DEVGRU）的若干小組，總人數約 200 余名。中央情報局（CIA）亦派出了約 100 名情報官與軍事顧問，配備輕型越野車與便攜式通信設備，與北方聯盟指揮官建立直接聯繫。英国特種空勤團（SAS）與皇家海軍陸戰隊第 40 突擊隊（RM）亦在 10 月中旬抵達，兵力約 150 人。加拿大 JTF2 約 80 名特勤官兵在 11 月初完成部署，澳洲 SASR 約 60 名特戰隊員亦加入前線。上述特種作戰力量以小組為單位，實施偵察、指引空襲與地面支援任務，形成與正規陸軍與空軍的緊密協同。
peopleEn: In the early phase of Enduring Freedom, U.S. Special Operations Command deployed elements of the 75th Ranger Regiment, several Operational Detachment‑Alpha (ODA) teams from the 1st Special Forces Group, and a handful of Naval Special Warfare Development Group (DEVGRU) squads, totaling roughly 200 operators. The Central Intelligence Agency also inserted about 100 intelligence officers and military advisors, equipped with light‑off‑road vehicles and portable radios, linking directly with Northern Alliance commanders. The United Kingdom’s Special Air Service (SAS) and Royal Marine 40 Commando arrived in mid‑October with roughly 150 troops, while Canada’s JTF2 contributed around 80 special‑operations personnel in early November and Australia’s SASR added about 60 operators to the front line. These small‑unit forces operated in close coordination with conventional army and air assets, conducting reconnaissance, directing air strikes and providing ground support throughout the campaign.
kits: 聯軍裝備的輕武器以 5.56 mm 北約口徑的 M16A2 步槍與 M4 卡賓槍為主，兩者均使用 M855 / M856 子彈；班用機槍包括 M249 自動步槍與 M240B 7.62 mm 機槍，後者發射 M80 子彈。手槍則採用 M9（Beretta 92）與 M11（SIG P226）。重型武器方面，步兵分隊配備 M2 .50 口徑重機槍與 Mk 19 40 mm 自動榴彈發射器，以提供壓制火力。地面車輛以 M998 高機動多用途輪式車（Humvee）為骨幹，配備防護裝甲板與 M2 重機槍或 Mk 19 榴彈發射器；部分單位使用 M113 裝甲運兵車與 LAV‑25 輕型裝甲車提升機動作戰能力。空中方面，AH‑64A 「阿帕奇」直升機配備 30 mm 鏈炮與地獄火（AGM‑114）飛彈，提供近距離空中支援；UH‑60A/L 「黑鷹」與 CH‑47D 「支努幹」則負責快速兵力投射與物資補給。固定翼戰機包括 F‑15C/D 「鷹」式、F‑15E 「打擊鷹」以及 F‑16C/D 「戰鬥獅」，皆配備 AIM‑120C/D 先進中程空對空飛彈與 GBU‑31/32 JDAM 精確制導炸彈；B‑1B 與 B‑2A 轟炸機在高空投放大量 JDAM，執行縱深轟炸任務。情報監視方面，MQ‑1A 「捕食者」無人機搭載 AGM‑114 地獄火飛彈，提供實時情報與定點打擊能力。所有作戰單位均配備 AN/PRC‑148 與 AN/PRC‑152 隨身通信電台，確保指揮控制暢通。
kitsEn: The coalition’s primary small arms were the 5.56 mm NATO M16A2 rifle and the M4 carbine, both firing M855/M856 ammunition; squad automatic weapons included the M249 SAW and the M240B 7.62 mm machine gun, using M80 ball ammunition. Handguns were the M9 (Beretta 92) and the M11 (SIG P226). Heavy weapons consisted of the M2 .50‑caliber heavy machine gun and the Mk 19 40 mm automatic grenade launcher for suppressive fire. Ground vehicles were based on the M998 Humvee, often fitted with armor kits and equipped with an M2 or Mk 19, while some units employed M113 armored personnel carriers and LAV‑25 wheeled armored vehicles for increased mobility. Aviation assets comprised AH‑64A Apache helicopters armed with a 30 mm chain gun and AGM‑114 Hellfire missiles for close‑air support; UH‑60A/L Black Hawks and CH‑47D Chinooks handled rapid troop insertion and resupply. Fixed‑wing fighters included F‑15C/D Eagles, F‑15E Strike Eagles and F‑16C/D Fighting Falcons, all equipped with AIM‑120C/D AMRAAMs and GBU‑31/32 JDAMs; B‑1B and B‑2A bombers conducted high‑altitude precision strikes. Intelligence‑surveillance‑reconnaissance (ISR) was provided by MQ‑1A Predator drones, which could launch Hellfire missiles for precision kill. All units used AN/PRC‑148 and AN/PRC‑152 handheld radios to maintain seamless command and control.
tactics: 聯軍作戰概念強調「空地一體」與「資訊化作戰」。在空襲階段，地面情報官（JTAC）利用激光指示器或 GPS 坐標，引導 F‑15E 與 B‑1B 投放 GBU‑31 JDAM，實現高精度打擊；MQ‑1A 「捕食者」無人機提供持續監視，並在確認目標後發射地獄火飛彈進行精準清除。空襲結束後，特種作戰小組迅速在目標區域實施快速繩降（fast‑rope）或透過 CH‑47D 直接著陸，與北方聯盟武裝配合建立前進基地（FOB）。在城鎮掃蕩行動中，步兵分隊以 Humvee 為機動平台，配備 M2 重機槍與 Mk 19 榴彈發射器，實施交叉火力压制；同時，AH‑64A 在低空提供近接支援，利用地獄火飛彈摧毀加固陣地。所有火力協調通過 AN/PRC‑148 與衛星通信完成，確保指令傳遞的即時性與準確性。整體而言，聯軍透過整合空中、地面與情報資源，形成多層次、精確且快速的打擊鏈，最大限度減少己方傷亡並快速削弱敵方指揮控制能力。
tacticsEn: The coalition’s operational concept stressed integrated air‑ground operations and information‑centric warfare. During the air‑campaign phase, Joint Terminal Attack Controllers (JTACs) on the ground used laser designators or GPS coordinates to guide F‑15E and B‑1B aircraft delivering GBU‑31 JDAMs, achieving high‑precision strikes. MQ‑1A Predator drones provided continuous surveillance and, once a target was confirmed, launched AGM‑114 Hellfire missiles for precision elimination. After air strikes, special‑operations teams rapidly inserted by fast‑rope or landed directly via CH‑47D helicopters, coordinated with Northern Alliance forces to establish forward operating bases (FOBs). In urban clearance operations, infantry squads used Humvees as mobile platforms armed with M2 heavy machine guns or Mk 19 grenade launchers to deliver cross‑fire suppression, while AH‑64A helicopters orbited at low altitude to provide close‑air support, employing Hellfire missiles against hardened positions. All fire‑support coordination was executed through AN/PRC‑148 radios and satellite communications, ensuring instantaneous and accurate transmission of orders. Overall, the coalition integrated air, ground and intelligence resources into a multi‑layered, precise and rapid strike chain, minimizing friendly casualties while rapidly degrading the enemy’s command and control.
data: 以下是持久自由行動的關鍵時間點與兵力部署資料：2001 年 10 月 7 日凌晨，美國與英國首先從紅海與波斯灣的航空母艦（第 5 艦隊）發動空襲，使用 B‑2、B‑1 轟炸機與 F‑16、F‑15E 進行首次精確轟炸，目標鎖定塔利班的指揮中心與防空設施。10 月 20 日，美國陸軍第 75 遊騎兵團的偵察分隊搭乘 MH‑60 直升機在巴爾赫省山區降落，與 CIA 人員會合並引導首波空襲。11 月 3 日，北方聯盟武裝在美軍空火力支援下突破塔利班前線，於 11 月 9 日奪回馬扎里沙里夫，俘獲大量塔利班官員。11 月 12 日，塔利班武裝撤離首都喀布爾，聯合國安理會隨後通過第 1378 號決議，支持成立過渡政府。12 月 5 日，《波恩協議》簽署，確立卡爾扎伊為臨時主席。12 月 7 日，美軍與英軍特種部隊在阿富汗南部展開聯合作戰，於 12 月 17 日攻占坎大哈，塔利班最高領袖奧馬爾逃往偏遠山區。2002 年 3 月初，代号「巨蟒行動」的美軍、澳軍與英軍特種分隊在沙伊科特山谷（Shah‑i‑Kot）展開激烈掃蕩，進行長達兩週的叢林與山地戰鬥，消耗塔利班剩餘兵力。此段時間內，聯軍總兵力約 10,000 人，其中美軍約 6,000 人，英軍 2,000 人，其他盟國約 2,000 人。這些時間與兵力數據提供了行動的完整輪廓，顯示出快速、空地結合與多方協調的特徵。
dataEn: The following key dates and force‑deployment data outline the timeline of Enduring Freedom: on 7 October 2001 at dawn, the United States and the United Kingdom launched the first air strikes from carriers in the Red Sea and Persian Gulf, employing B‑2 and B‑1 bombers together with F‑16s and F‑15Es against Taliban command centers and air‑defence sites. On 20 October, a reconnaissance detachment of the U.S. 75th Ranger Regiment inserted by MH‑60 helicopters in the Hindu Kush mountains, linking up with CIA personnel to direct the initial wave of air raids. On 3 November, Northern Alliance forces, supported by U.S. air power, broke through Taliban front lines and, on 9 November, liberated Mazar‑i‑Sharif, capturing senior Taliban officials. By 12 November, Taliban forces evacuated Kabul, prompting the UN Security Council to adopt Resolution 1378 endorsing an interim administration. The Bonn Agreement was signed on 5 December, establishing Hamid Karzai as Chairman of the Interim Administration. On 7 December, U.S. and British special‑operations units began joint operations in southern Afghanistan, leading to the capture of Kandahar on 17 December, while Taliban leader Mullah Omar fled to remote mountainous areas. In early March 2002, Operation Anaconda involved U.S., Australian and British special‑operations teams in the Shah‑i‑Kot valley, conducting a two‑week intense mountain and jungle fight that further degraded remaining Taliban resistance. Throughout this period, total coalition strength peaked at roughly 10,000 troops, with about 6,000 Americans, 2,000 British and 2,000 personnel from other allies. These dates and force numbers illustrate the rapid, air‑ground integrated and multinational nature of the campaign.
cause: 阿富汗戰爭的根本起因可追溯至 2001 年 9 月 11 日發生在美國的恐怖攻擊。基地組織（al‑Qaeda）在該日挾持民航機撞擊世界貿易中心與五角大樓，造成近 3,000 人死亡。美國政府指控在阿富汗境內的基地組織訓練營由塔利班政權提供庇護，並要求塔利班交出其領袖奧薩馬·本·拉登。塔利班領袖穆罕默德·奧馬爾公開拒絕外國干預，並持續為基地組織提供安全港與物資支援。面對無法透過外交手段達成的撤離要求，美國依據《聯合國憲章》第 51 條的自衛權，決定以軍事手段消除威脅。2001 年 10 月 7 日，美國與盟友啟動「持久自由行動」，目標明確：摧毁基地組織在阿富汗的訓練設施、瓦解塔利班武裝，並在政治上迫使其下台，以防止未來的恐怖攻擊。此役的正當性在於保護本國公民免受武裝攻擊，並透過國際合作維護全球安全。
causeEn: The root cause of the Afghanistan war traces back to the terrorist attacks of 11 September 2001 in the United States, in which al‑Qaeda hijacked commercial airliners and crashed them into the World Trade Center and the Pentagon, killing nearly 3,000 people. The U.S. government held the Taliban regime responsible for providing sanctuary to al‑Qaeda training camps in Afghanistan and demanded the handover of its leader, Osama bin Laden. Taliban leader Mullah Omar publicly refused any foreign interference and continued to offer safe haven and logistical support to al‑Qaeda. With diplomatic avenues exhausted, the United States invoked its inherent right of self‑defence under Article 51 of the United Nations Charter and decided to use military force to eliminate the threat. On 7 October 2001, the United States and its allies initiated Operation Enduring Freedom with the explicit objectives of destroying al‑Qaeda’s training infrastructure in Afghanistan, dismantling the Taliban’s armed forces, and forcing the regime’s removal from power to prevent future terrorist attacks. The war’s legitimacy was grounded in protecting its citizens from armed attack and in collective international efforts to uphold global security.
impact: 戰爭的即時影響是塔利班政權在不到三個月的時間內被推翻。2001 年 12 月底，卡爾扎伊成立過渡政府，開始在國際社會的支持下重建國家行政體系。與此同時，許多塔利班戰士被迫撤入巴基斯坦邊境的偏遠山區，形成游擊根據地，並逐步重組為武裝叛亂組織，對新政府與聯軍維持長期游擊戰。阿富汗的安全形勢在 2002 年至 2006 年間相對穩定，但隨著叛亂活動加劇，衝突再度升級，成為持久的地區戰爭。戰爭還加劇了巴基斯坦內部的宗教與民族緊張，因為巴國成為塔利班領導人逃亡的主要通道，並在情報與後勤上提供隱蔽支援。國際社會在軍事干預的同時，亦投入巨額資金用於阿富汗的國家建設與人道救援，改變了該地區的經濟與社會結構。總體而言，持久自由行動在短期內實現了主要軍事目標，但也在長期導致地區安全形勢的深刻變化。
impactEn: The immediate impact of the war was the overthrow of the Taliban regime in less than three months. By late December 2001, an interim government headed by Hamid Karzai was established under international auspices, beginning the reconstruction of Afghanistan’s administrative structures. Concurrently, many Taliban fighters withdrew into the rugged border regions of Pakistan, where they regrouped as an insurgency and gradually resumed guerrilla warfare against the new government and coalition forces. From 2002 through 2006, security was relatively stable, but as the insurgency gained momentum, conflict escalated, turning Afghanistan into a protracted regional war. The war also deepened internal religious and ethnic tensions in Pakistan, as the country became a conduit for Taliban leaders fleeing Afghanistan and provided them with intelligence and logistical support. While the international community invested heavily in nation‑building and humanitarian aid, the military intervention reshaped Afghanistan’s economic and social landscape. Overall, Enduring Freedom achieved its short‑term military objective of toppling the Taliban, but it also set the stage for long‑term security challenges that would define the region for decades.
result: 最終結果顯示，聯軍在 2001 年底成功剷除塔利班政權，基地組織在阿富汗的訓練營大多被摧毁，核心領導人如本·拉登在 2011 年於巴基斯坦阿伯塔巴德被美軍特種部隊擊斃，象徵性地結束了對其的直接追捕。然而，塔利班武裝並未被彻底消滅，其在阿富汗南部的根據地在 2000 年代中後期重新集結，並在 2021 年 8 月重新奪回首都喀布爾，完成政權更迭。美國及其北約盟國在 2021 年完成撤軍，結束了長達 20 年的軍事介入。從戰略角度看，持久自由行動展示了精確空中打擊、特種部隊與當地武裝相結合的混合戰模式，並檢驗了信息共享與聯盟作战的可行性。但同時也暴露了長期佔領與國家建設的困難，以及在缺乏持續政治共識的情況下，軍事勝利的可持續性受到質疑。這場戰爭的教訓對未來的反恐與衝突管理仍有深遠的參考價值。
resultEn: The ultimate result showed that by the end of 2001 the coalition had succeeded in dismantling the Taliban government and largely destroying al‑Qaeda’s training camps in Afghanistan. The killing of Osama bin Laden in May 2011 in Abbottabad, Pakistan, by U.S. special‑operations forces symbolically concluded the pursuit of the organization’s leadership. However, the Taliban were not entirely eradicated; they regrouped in the southern Afghan provinces and, after years of insurgency, recaptured Kabul in August 2021, completing a political comeback. The United States and its NATO allies completed their withdrawal later that year, ending 20 years of military involvement. From a strategic perspective, Operation Enduring Freedom demonstrated the effectiveness of combining precision air strikes, special‑operations forces and local allies in a hybrid warfare model, while also testing multinational command, control and information‑sharing mechanisms. Nonetheless, the experience exposed the difficulties of prolonged occupation and nation‑building without sustained political consensus, raising questions about the sustainability of military victories. The lessons learned continue to inform future counter‑terrorism and conflict‑resolution strategies.
